title: UNIVERS: Learning UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis for generalizable one-shot landmark localization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29098v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-shot landmark localization in volume scans with varying fields of view (FOVs) is challenging. While existing self-supervised learning methods have shown promising performance, they rely on contrastive learning built upon augmented views of the same image, which inherently limits their generalization in cross-modality scenarios. This motivates research on cross-modality embedding learning using paired multi-modality images. However, existing methods suffer from not only limited training data, but also the requirement of multi-stage iterative training. To address these limitations, we propose UNIVERS, an end-to-end trainable framework that learns UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis. Our framework leverages diverse pseudo-data synthesized from organ shape templates, with randomization applied to semantic layout, visual appearance, FOV, and spatial pose. translated_title: UNIVERS：通过随机化合成学习通用体素级嵌入以实现可泛化的单样本关键点定位
translated_abstract: 在具有不同视野（FOV）的体数据扫描中进行单样本关键点定位是一项具有挑战性的任务。虽然现有的自监督学习方法已经展现出有前景的性能，但它们依赖于基于同一图像增强视图的对比学习，这从本质上限制了其在跨模态场景中的泛化能力。这促使研究者开展利用成对多模态图像进行跨模态嵌入学习的研究。然而，现有方法不仅受到训练数据有限的制约，还需要多阶段迭代训练。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了UNIVERS，一个通过随机化合成学习通用体素级嵌入的端到端可训练框架。我们的框架利用从器官形状模板合成的多样化伪数据，并对语义布局、视觉外观、视野和空间姿态进行随机化。结合跨域判别性体素级对比学习……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了UNIVERS框架，通过从器官形状模板随机化合成多样化伪数据（对语义布局、视觉外观、视野和空间姿态进行随机化），以端到端方式学习通用体素级嵌入，从而实现可泛化的跨模态单样本关键点定位。
en_tdlr: UNIVERS is an end-to-end trainable framework that learns universal voxel-wise embeddings via randomized synthesis of diverse pseudo-data from organ shape templates, enabling generalizable cross-modality one-shot landmark localization.
